ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat (ALPHV / Noberus) Rust encryptor execution — `--access-token` CLI signature with anti-recovery chain
ucs.description: Hunts the Rust-based ALPHV/BlackCat encryptor by its hardcoded launch contract: it refuses to run without `--access-token <64-hex>` and is typically wrapped with `--paths`, `--child`, `--propagated`, `--no-vm-kill`, or `--no-prop-servers`. Paired with the actor's signature `vssadmin delete shadows`/`bcdedit recoveryenabled No`/`wmic shadowcopy delete` impact chain that Microsoft (DEV-0237) and Mandiant attribute specifically to this RaaS family.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name values(Processes.process_hash) as process_hash values(Processes.process) as process from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*--access-token*" AND (Processes.process="*--paths*" OR Processes.process="*--child*" OR Processes.process="*--propagated*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-servers*")) OR (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe") AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name host index sourcetype | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where (match(process,"(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{64}")) OR process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe") | search NOT user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process) as cmdline values(process_name) as processes values(parent_process_name) as parents dc(process_name) as proc_variety by dest user | where proc_variety>=1 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV encryptor — Rust binary fingerprint + anti-recovery chain
let WindowHours = 24h;
let Encryptor = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(WindowHours)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "--access-token"
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{64}"
       or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--child", "--propagated", "--no-vm-kill", "--no-prop-servers", "--paths")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
              ProcessCommandLine, SHA256,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              Signal="alphv_encryptor";
let AntiRecovery = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(WindowHours)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"     and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy"))
         or (FileName =~ "powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
              ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Signal="anti_recovery";
union Encryptor, AntiRecovery
| summarize Hits=count(), Distinct=dcount(Signal),
            FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp),
            Signals=make_set(Signal, 8),
            Cmdlines=make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Binaries=make_set(FileName, 8),
            SHA=make_set(SHA256, 8)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where Distinct >= 2 or Signals has "alphv_encryptor"
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV encryptor + anti-recovery chain on Sentinel (4688 from SecurityEvent)
let WindowHours = 24h;
let Encryptor = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(WindowHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where CommandLine has "--access-token"
    | where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{64}"
       or CommandLine has_any ("--child", "--propagated", "--no-vm-kill", "--no-prop-servers", "--paths")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Signal="alphv_encryptor";
let AntiRecovery = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(WindowHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe"     and CommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"  and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Signal="anti_recovery";
union Encryptor, AntiRecovery
| summarize Hits=count(), Distinct=dcount(Signal),
            FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),
            Signals=make_set(Signal, 8),
            Cmdlines=make_set(CommandLine, 8),
            Binaries=make_set(NewProcessName, 8)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where Distinct >= 2 or Signals has "alphv_encryptor"
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat/ALPHV Rust Encryptor Launch Signature (--access-token + propagation flags)
id: 8c5a3b6f-4a91-4f1c-9d8a-3b1e2a5c9e10
status: experimental
description: Detects ALPHV/BlackCat ransomware encryptor execution. The Rust binary refuses to start without a 64-hex --access-token argument and is typically wrapped with --child, --propagated, --no-vm-kill or --no-prop-servers.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/06/13/the-many-lives-of-blackcat-ransomware/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/noberus-blackcat-ransomware
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.execution
  - actor.alphv
  - actor.blackcat
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{64}'
  selection_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '--child'
      - '--propagated'
      - '--no-vm-kill'
      - '--no-prop-servers'
      - '--paths'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_token and selection_flag and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorized red-team replays of public ALPHV samples
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @CommandLine:(*"--access-token"* AND (*"--paths"* OR *"--child"* OR *"--propagated"* OR *"--no-vm-kill"* OR *"--no-prop-servers"*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 CommandLine=/--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{64}/i
| CommandLine=/(--paths|--child|--propagated|--no-vm-kill|--no-prop-servers)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function={ count() | sample := selectLast(CommandLine) })
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(delete\s+shadows|shadowcopy\s+delete|recoveryenabled\s+No|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)/i | groupBy(aid, function=count(as=anti_recovery_count))}, field=aid, include=[anti_recovery_count])
| anti_recovery_count >= 1
ucs.rationale: The `--access-token <64-hex>` argument is a hardcoded gate inside the BlackCat/ALPHV Rust binary documented by Microsoft (DEV-0237 / BlackCat blog), Mandiant (Noberus), and the FBI FLASH (MC-000167-MW). Without it the encryptor exits, and the accompanying `--child`, `--propagated`, `--no-vm-kill`, `--no-prop-servers` flags are unique to this family — they don't appear in Conti, LockBit, Royal, Aki

ucs.title: [LLM] ALPHV/BlackCat data-theft staging — rclone/MEGAcmd exfil to mega.nz from non-admin endpoints
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature double-extortion exfiltration step: ALPHV affiliates consistently stage data with rclone (or MEGAcmd) and push to MEGA cloud storage prior to deploying the encryptor — distinct from Conti's preference for FileZilla and LockBit's StealBit. Detection chains the rclone process with a `mega:` remote / mega.nz endpoint reach-out and excludes the IT-admin baseline.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_hash) as hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.process_name="MEGAcmdServer.exe" OR Processes.process_name="MEGAclient.exe") (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.co.nz*" OR Processes.process="*--config*" OR (Processes.process="*copy*" AND Processes.process="*--transfers*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name host | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search NOT user IN ("*$","SYSTEM") NOT dest IN ("BACKUP-*","IT-ADMIN-*") | join type=left dest, user [| tstats summariesonly=true values(All_Traffic.dest) as remote_ips count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.app="https" (All_Traffic.dest_host="*.mega.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.userstorage.mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="gfs*.userstorage.mega.co.nz") by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user | rename All_Traffic.src as dest All_Traffic.user as user] | where isnotnull(remote_ips) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// ALPHV/BlackCat double-extortion exfil — rclone/MEGAcmd → mega.nz
let WindowDays = 7d;
let RcloneExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(WindowDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("rclone.exe","MEGAcmdServer.exe","MEGAclient.exe")
         or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("rclone.exe","MEGAcmdServer.exe","MEGAclient.exe")
         or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","copy ","sync ","--transfers","--config","--ignore-existing","--multi-thread-streams")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
              ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let MegaNet = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(WindowDays)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz")
         or RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)gfs\d+\.userstorage\.mega\.co\.nz"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project NetTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
RcloneExec
| join kind=inner MegaNet on DeviceName, AccountName
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 1h)
| summarize FirstProc=min(ProcTime), LastNet=max(NetTime),
            DistinctUrls=dcount(RemoteUrl), Urls=make_set(RemoteUrl, 16),
            Cmdlines=make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Hashes=make_set(SHA256, 4)
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| where DistinctUrls >= 1
| order by LastNet desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// ALPHV/BlackCat exfil via rclone/MEGAcmd correlated with mega.nz egress (ASIM)
let WindowDays = 7d;
let RcloneExec = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(WindowDays)
    | where TargetProcessName has_any ("rclone.exe","MEGAcmdServer.exe","MEGAclient.exe")
         or ActingProcessFileOriginalName =~ "rclone.exe"
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","--transfers","--config","--ignore-existing","--multi-thread-streams","copy ","sync ")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let MegaNet = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(WindowDays)
    | where DstHostname has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz")
         or Url has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz")
    | where SrcUsername !endswith "$"
    | project NetTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername=SrcUsername,
              DstHostname, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, NetworkBytes;
RcloneExec
| join kind=inner MegaNet on DvcHostname, ActorUsername
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 1h)
| summarize FirstProc=min(ProcTime), LastNet=max(NetTime),
            BytesOut=sum(NetworkBytes), Urls=make_set(DstHostname, 16),
            Cmdlines=make_set(TargetProcessCommandLine, 8)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername
| order by LastNet desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\rclone.exe OR *\Rclone.exe OR *\RCLONE.EXE OR *\MEGAcmdServer.exe OR *\megacmdserver.exe OR *\MEGAclient.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*"rclone"* AND (*"mega:"* OR *"mega.nz"* OR *"mega.co.nz"* OR *"--transfers"* OR *"--config"* OR *"--multi-thread-streams"*))) -@User:*$) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(*mega.nz OR *mega.co.nz OR *userstorage.mega.co.nz))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (ImageFileName=/\\(rclone|MEGAcmdServer|MEGAclient)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/rclone(\.exe)?\s/i)
| CommandLine=/(mega:|mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|--transfers|--multi-thread-streams|--ignore-existing|--config|\s(copy|sync)\s)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|userstorage\.mega\.co\.nz)$/i | groupBy(aid, function={ count(as=mega_dns) | mega_domains := selectLast(DomainName) })}, field=aid, include=[mega_dns, mega_domains])
| mega_dns >= 1
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, mega_domains], function={ count() | sample_cmd := selectLast(CommandLine) })
